 News › News News › School holiday tomorrow, 3 November: Are schools closed on Monday? Check state-wise updates School holiday tomorrow, 3 November: Are schools closed on Monday? Check state-wise updates
 Adhya Sarna Updated: Nov 2, 2026, 19:44 IST School Holiday on November 3, 2026 Schools are likely to stay open on Monday, November 3, 2026, in most states. No nationwide holiday has been announced. Local closures are still possible, so parents should check their school’s notice before getting children ready for school.
 State-wise school holiday status for November 3, 2026 
 Delhi-NCR school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools in Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad and Faridabad should run as usual unless local authorities or your school announce a closure. Parents with their children studying in schools near CP or areas affected by the protests must check with school authorities in the morning for any closure.
 Tamil Nadu school holiday tomorrow 
 Tamil Nadu schools were closed over the last few days due to heavy rain. Schools were closed on Monday, October 26, 2026 as well, and are now confirmed to be closed on November 3, 2026 as well, due to Cyclone Murasu.
 Also read: Schools closed in Andhra Pradesh and Chennai due to Cyclone Murasu: Check latest school holiday updates and affected areas 
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools are expected to stay open on November 3. District officials or schools following their own festive calendar may announce separate closures.
 Haryana school holiday tomorrow 
 No statewide holiday has been confirmed. Schools are likely to stay open unless officials issue a separate order.
 Himachal Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools should follow their normal schedule. 
 No statewide holiday has been confirmed.
 Bihar school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools may follow regular timings. Check your school’s official notice for last-minute changes.
 Rajasthan school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools are expected to stay open. A district administration or school may still issue its own notice.
 Uttarakhand school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools are expected to stay open. The state’s 2026 holiday calendar does not list November 3 as a public holiday.
 School holiday due to Cyclone Arnab and Cyclone Murasu? 
 Cyclone Arnab made landfall on October 28 and brought strong winds and heavy rains with it. Schools in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Jharkhand declared school holidays in many districts due to the same. This week, schools in Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu will be closed due to stormic cyclone Murasu. Please confirm school holidays caused by weather but official government announcements. Schools were closed on November 2 due to the cyclone.
 For further confirmation, check official advisories. 
 What should parents check before sending children to school? 
 Closures can come at short notice, especially in bad weather. Before you leave home, check:
 Your school’s WhatsApp group, SMS or app
 The school website or latest circular
 Announcements from the District Magistrate or district administration
 Notices from your state education department
 Local weather warnings
 Road and transport conditions in your area
 Tip: Many closure orders are posted in the evening, so check again before bedtime and early in the morning.
 Quick FAQs on school holiday tomorrow
 Is there a school holiday in Delhi on November 3, 2026? 
 No school holiday has been confirmed for Delhi-NCR.
 Are schools closed in UP tomorrow? 
 Schools are expected to stay open unless the district or school announces a closure.
 When is the next big school holiday? 
 Diwali falls on November 8, 2026. Check your school’s notice for exact break dates.
 Where can I find official updates? 
 Check the school’s circulars and state education department’s website.
